description: Details required by Conditions 3 (submission of details - a) Samples of facing materials other than represented in brickwork panel; b) Notwithstanding the approved drawings, positioning, form and detailed design of the new dormers at main roof level at a scale of 1:20. These details should include a section; d Notwithstanding the approved drawings, glazing to new sash windows and elevations, including sample, and associated glazing bar profile at 1:5; e) New lightweight rear infills at 1:20, including section and details of framing, cladding and type of glazing; h) notwithstanding the approved drawings, CCTV cameras and entry intercom, including positioning, size, colour and means of fixing; j) Garden elevation of garage extension at 1:20, which should include details of materials and finishes; k) Notwithstanding the approved drawings, any alterations to garden boundary walls: l) Notwithstanding the approved drawings, external air condensor enclosure at a scale of 1:20, including form, design, facing materials and colour/finish. The enclosure should be low level and not extend up to the underside of the adjacent staircase; m) Notwithstanding the approved drawings, design of new external door to lower ground floor front lobby(D.LG.01) and to lower ground floor rear TV room(D.LG.14) at 1:10, including section, materials and finish) and 6 (Works to match sample planels required) of Listed Building Consent LB/24/06983 (Redevelopment involving demolition of lower ground, ground and first floor rear extensions; replacement of roof dormers; addition of a roof window; installation of solar panels on mansard roof; lowering of front vaults; partial basement extension under rear garage; full width extension and provision of roof terrace to rear garage; installation of air handling units in garden; construction of lower ground, ground and first floor replacement rear extensions; and associated internal refurbishment work)
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
